- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **139** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 860152604206718bdc849b09ca9b527e92933f8b` → `packageMentionDocs`.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `ba23f992c726c7895ff05dec6875d3ae27b9f172`
Local-runs: none

Inputs: card #20471 (body and all eleven comments, the `os-dev-report` `6025479851` included), PR #22038 (body, three-file list, net diff against `main` at the head), the 32 check-runs on the head as read at 2026-10-06T21:22Z (read once, not polled), objectui at the pin `a58626c88dc8` read with `git show`, and `main` (`86015260`, the PR's base) read from the local checkout. Nothing was built, run or re-run; the one count below is a grep-and-awk reading of files already read.

### ① Derived judgments

- **Accept set and public type surface: unchanged. Right.** The nine changed lines in `packages/spec/src/ui/component.zod.ts` all sit inside docblocks (every added line is a ` * ` comment line); no key, default, enum member, `.describe()` string, type or export moves. The script edit is one constant and its docblock. What does move is published bytes: `@objectstack/spec`'s `files[]` ships `src/**/*.zod.ts` verbatim, so the three docblock edits are released text. Judged in ② below.
- **Three quotes, each true at the pin. Right.** Read with `git show a58626c88dc8:…` in objectui:
  - `packages/components/src/renderers/action/action-button.tsx:215` is `type: schema.actionType,`, the first property line of the `const forwarded: ActionDef = {` literal that opens at `:205`; the line is unique in the file. The range `:215-318` ends on the `objectName` forward (`:318`).
  - `packages/components/src/renderers/action/action-icon.tsx:160` is `type: schema.actionType,`, the same literal (opens `:147`), unique in the file; `:211` is its `objectName` forward.
  - `packages/components/src/renderers/basic/data-list.tsx:42` is the `readProps` opening line (`const props = readProps`, then the generic's opening angle bracket and brace) and `:47` closes the call. The same line also sits at `:125` (`RepeaterRenderer`'s `readProps`), exactly as the PR's ablation C reports: drift still reds, the relocation hint cannot name one line. Quoting it as-is is the gate's own prescription (the range's first non-blank line), and making it unique would re-anchor a correct record. Right.
  - Each spelled path resolves to exactly one file at the pin (one `action-button.tsx`, one `action-icon.tsx`, one `data-list.tsx` in objectui's 7754-file tree), so the gate's suffix resolution is unambiguous.
- **Syntax is the gate's. Right.** Each assertion is a backticked `path:range`, the words `first line`, and a backticked quote, which is `ASSERTION` in `check-objectui-pin-citations.ts` (`:460-463` on `main`); the wrap onto the next comment line is joined with a space by `flatten`, which the pattern's whitespace run absorbs. No bare near-miss form.
- **Spelling the path was necessary. Right.** A path-less continuation inherits the nearest preceding FULL anchor. On `main` that is `static-params.ts:91-101` (`component.zod.ts:3416`) for both action rows and `action-group.tsx:40-42` (`:3902`) for the definition list, so a bare `:215-318` / `:160-211` / `:42-47` would have been checked in the wrong file. The PR body's claim is measured true.
- **Floor delta equals the quotes added. Right.** `main` carries 7 assertions (all in `src/ui/view.zod.ts:2187-2225`); the diff adds exactly 3 (all in `component.zod.ts`); `ASSERTED_ANCHOR_FLOOR` goes 7 to 10. The self-test holds the floor as an equality against the live count, and the CI job that runs this gate on a checkout of this repo alone (`Type Check · source gates`, `lint.yml:5930`, ordinary mode plus `--self-test`) is `success` on the head.
- **The new gate docblock's sentences, one by one:**
  - "re-read at pin `a58626c88`": `.objectui-sha` on `main` is `a58626c88dc85954bd0af24f16ebb69454c03eee`. True.
  - "the `forwarded: ActionDef` literal of `action:button` and of `action:icon`, where the keys each row forwards to the runner are enumerated": the two ranges are those literals' property lists (above). True.
  - "the `readProps` call of `element:definition-list`, whose type literal is that row's key set": the literal names `items`, `columns`, `inline` and `className`; the row declares `items`, `columns` and `inline` (`className` is a component-level key the row leaves to `COMPONENT_LEVEL_GUIDANCE`). True for the row's own keys, one word loose on `className`. Unpublished text (`scripts/` is not in `files[]`): a nit, not a defect.
  - "their cited lines do not hold at that pin" for `action:group`, `action:menu` and `element:repeater`: measured true. `action-group.tsx:303` at the pin is `const handleExecute = useCallback(` (the `actions` read is `:300-301`); `action-menu.tsx:342` is a comment line (the `actions` read is `:335`); `data-list.tsx:97-107` is the definition list's registration `columns` input (`RepeaterRenderer`'s `readProps` is `:125-135`). `action-button.tsx` and `action-icon.tsx` are byte-identical across the `0abd4f9f8` to `a58626c88` hop; `action-group.tsx`, `action-menu.tsx` and `static-params.ts` are not.
  - "418 objectui anchors in `packages/spec/src` still carry none, read against objectui `a58626c88`": reproduced from read data with the gate's own rule (every full anchor in `.ts` / `.tsx` / `.mts` under `packages/spec/src`, kept when its path resolves to exactly one file at the pin, dropped when a content assertion claims the same file, target and range). 496 full anchors at the head (493 on `main` plus the 3 this diff spells out; the PR's "496 seen" agrees), 427 resolve to one file, 9 of those carry an assertion (the tenth assertion is the `:420` continuation in `view.zod.ts`, not a full anchor), 418 remain, 239 of them in `component.zod.ts`. True. Replacing the stale "145" with a count tied to a named pin is the right form for a number that moves at every bump.
  - "`--verify-anchors` prints that worklist": `main`'s gate does (`:1240-1266`). True.
- **The three shipped docblock sentences** ("Forwarded to the runner (`action-button.tsx:215-318` first line …)", "Forwarded (`action-icon.tsx:160-211` first line …)", "through `readProps` (`data-list.tsx:42-47` first line …, `properties` first)") are each true at the pin; the pre-existing claims around them (`:216`, `:220`, `:48`, `:49`, `:63`, `:66`, `:68`, `properties` first) are not re-judged here.
- **The "load-bearing anchor" reading. Right.** One quote per row at the props-read site (the annotated `forwarded` literal; the `readProps` type literal) is a defensible reading of triage's "the read points each row's key set rests on": it is where the key set is read as a set, a line shift anywhere above it in the same file also reds (the mismatch report names the relocated line), and quoting every per-key read would be the bulk fill triage excluded (`6022454625`, `6023252757`).
- **Check-runs on the head, as read:** 15 `success` (`Auto Label`, `Part-of PR must not also close its card`, `The card this PR closes must claim this branch`, `Type Check · source gates`, `Type Check · debt ledger`, `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, `Flag docs affected by code changes`, `No other open PR may claim the same single-writer path`, `No other open PR may claim the same issue`, `Check PR Size`, `Check Changeset`, `filter`, `Check Documentation Links`, `Spec property liveness`); 3 `skipped` (`Build Docs`, `Console Pin Gate`, `Packed-tarball smoke (opt-in)`); 14 `in_progress` (`Build Core`, `Test Core` 1 to 6, `Dogfood Regression Gate` 1 to 3, `Dogfood Verify CLI`, `Temporal Conformance`, `Type Check · consumer gates`, `Type Check · workspace`, `Lint & Repo Gates`). None `failure`. The gate families this diff can move (pin citations and the floor equality, changeset, Part-of) are among the completed successes; the in-progress ones are build and test lanes a comment-only diff does not reach. This record does not wait on them: their conclusions are the gate verdicts when they land.

### ② Semver level

- **`patch` for `@objectstack/spec`. Right, and `skip-changeset` would have been wrong.** `files[]` ships `src/**/*.zod.ts`, so the edited docblocks are published bytes (and TSDoc reaches the `dist` declarations); a diff that publishes from a released package takes a changeset. The script edit alone would publish nothing (`scripts/` is not in `files[]`). Precedent on `main` agrees twice: `15fe567c` (#21642), a comment-only re-anchor of `src/**`, shipped `'@objectstack/spec': patch` with a bare `no` declaration; and `.changeset/objectui-pin-citations-a58626c88dc8.md`, the last pin bump's citation re-read, is the same shape.
- **The changeset body** (`.changeset/20471-component-row-anchor-quotes.md`) names the three rows, the pin, what now reds, that the other three rows carry no quote yet, and closes "Comment text only: no schema, key, type or export changes". Each sentence is true per ①. It carries the declaration line bare, and no ADR-0087 marker is owed (nothing is breaking). `Check Changeset` on the head is `success`.
- **The PR body's declaration** reads as `no`: the line is `Clause-②: no (docblock text and a gate constant: the accept set and the public type surface are unchanged)`, and the fleet's one reader (`scripts/pm/clause2-line.mjs`, `readArmToken`) takes the value and leaves a parenthetical that names no arm alone, which `Check Changeset` confirmed by passing. `no` is the right answer: no accept-set widening, no public-surface growth, no narrowing.

### ③ Boundary flags

The dev's report is `6025479851` on #20471. Every deviation, the open question and both out-of-scope findings, answered or escalated:

- **Deviation 1, `Part of #20471` rather than a closing keyword: right.** The card's landing site names six rows; this head quotes three. A closing keyword would have marked a half-delivered card finished on merge, the exact failure the `Part-of Closing-Keyword Guard` exists for, and that guard is `success` on the head. The card stays open, correctly.
- **Deviation 2, a `patch` changeset over the dev agent's "comment-only does not publish" fast lane: right.** AGENTS.md's rule and the measured `files[]` govern; see ②.
- **Deviation 3, "145" replaced with "418" in the floor's own paragraph: right**, inside the claimed file, and the number is established (①).
- **Deviation 4, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` not measured locally (87 unbuilt packages): accepted as a declared narrowing.** CI hosts that gate on a full build (`ci.yml:2319`, inside `Build Core`), `in_progress` as read. The dev's positive controls (the new text reaches 2 declaration files and 0 runtime JS files) cannot be repeated read-only, so `Build Core`'s conclusion is the verdict of record for it.
- **Deviation 5, the PM's saved gate file used as a lead, 82 commands re-derived at the head and reconciled (81 run, 1 not measured, 0 unrun): fine.** Re-deriving at the head is the rule, not a departure from it.
- **Deviation 6, read-only depth-1 object fetches into `/home/user/objectui` (`FETCH_HEAD` moved; no ref, branch or worktree touched): acceptable.** Reading the pin's objects is what a citation re-read needs; this review read the same objects.
- **`open_questions[0]`, how the remaining three rows (`action:group`, `action:menu`, `element:repeater`) get their quotes: answered A, escalated to the seat to file.** Their records cite lines that do not hold at the pin (verified in ①), and a quote goes only beside a line that does. Option A, a sub-issue of #20471 that re-measures those three records at the pin (plus `action:button`'s `static-params.ts:91-101`, where `readStaticParamValues` is declared at `:98` at the pin, and `element:definition-list`'s `:82` registration prose, which the pin's registration no longer matches: the `columns` enum publishes the NUMBERS 1 and 2 at `:98-107`), re-words the two "static values" parentheticals objectui#11638 emptied, then quotes each row's load-bearing anchor and raises the floor by that count, keeps one PR to one decision and matches the gate's own rule that a moved read point is reported, not re-pointed, under a quote ratchet. B would breach the claimed surface and put about 45 line edits under a review scoped to quotes. C is the route the card's own history records failing four times (`6022454625`). The filing is the dispatching seat's act, not this record's; the measurement to file from is in the PR body's "Finding" tables.
- **`out_of_scope_findings[0]`, stale read-point records in section 4b (class a, and class b against the section's "each is cited below at this pin"): confirmed and escalated into that same sub-issue.** Section 4b's hop note (`component.zod.ts:3207-3219` on `main`) says the `a58626c88` hop moved only the `objectName` forward in `action-group.tsx` / `action-menu.tsx`; measured, the `actions` reads and the member forwards moved too (`:303` to `:300-301` and `:329-382` to `:325-374`; `:342` to `:335` and `:264-328` to `:261-321`), and every `element:repeater` anchor in `data-list.tsx` sits 28 lines lower than recorded (blob `5237dc269`, 220 lines, through `e420df310`; blob `e54574ef4`, 262 lines, at `31971ff1e` and `a58626c88`). These docblocks ship in `@objectstack/spec`, so each release freezes the wrong read points until they are re-measured. Leaving them untouched in this PR is right: the claimed surface is quotes plus the floor.
- **`out_of_scope_findings[1]`, the non-unique `data-list.tsx` quote and the un-quoted historical member docblock (`.objectui-sha` pin `2e818d0b51ec`): noted, not filed. Agreed.** A quote is checked against the CURRENT pin and would turn a dated record into a current claim; the non-unique line still reds on drift.
- **Serial constraint:** triage's "an open bump PR that edits `component.zod.ts` goes first". The claim (`6024139898`) recorded none open, and the head's `No other open PR may claim the same single-writer path` is `success`.
